targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_monitor") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price_per_kwh") |> last()

panels.description: Current cost rate based on power consumption

targets.query:
price = (from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_monitor") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price_per_kwh") |> group() |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy_monitor") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "power_w") |> group() |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r._value / 1000.0) * price}))
